experiences.description:
• Led the redesign of the customer billing platform, moving 40 services to an event driven architecture
• Cut median page load time from 3.1s to 1.2s by splitting bundles and caching API responses at the edge
• Mentored six engineers through a structured growth plan, four of whom were promoted within a year
• Introduced contract tests between teams, which removed most integration bugs before release
• Built a self service reporting tool used daily by 300 people across finance and operations
• Ran the on call rotation and wrote the runbooks that halved the time to resolve incidents
• Partnered with product and design to ship a new onboarding flow that lifted activation by 18%
• Migrated the main database to a managed cluster with zero downtime and full point in time recovery
• Automated the release pipeline end to end so any engineer could ship safely several times a day
• Wrote internal guides on accessibility and performance that became the default team checklist
• Reduced cloud spend by 27% through right sizing, reserved capacity and removing idle resources
• Represented the team at the architecture review board and drove three cross team standards
